title: Etale/pro-etale inverse-image square commutes with derived scalar comparison
statement:
Let $f:X\to Y$ be any morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], and let $a:A\to B$ be a homomorphism of discrete commutative rings. Use constant ring sheaves [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf] and ordinary unbounded derived module categories on the small etale and pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. For $R=A,B$, $Z=X,Y$ and $t=e,p$ denoting the etale and pro-etale sites, write $C_Z^R=\nu_Z^*$ for comparison inverse image [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism], $l_R=f_{\mathrm{et},R}^*$ and $p_R=f_{\mathrm{proet},R}^*$ [def-kun-projection-formula-map, def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations], and $T_Z^t=B_Z\otimes^L_{A_Z}-$ for scalar extension [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]. Let $d_R:p_RC_Y^R\xrightarrow{\sim}C_X^Rl_R$ be the canonical inverse-image square of [sk-thm-pe-direct-image-comparison]. Let $c^e:l_BT_Y^e\xrightarrow{\sim}T_X^el_A$ be the K-flat-normalized comparison [def-pur-etale-scalar-pullback-iso], and let $c^p:p_BT_Y^p\xrightarrow{\sim}T_X^pp_A$ and $\delta_Z:T_Z^pC_Z^A\xrightarrow{\sim}C_Z^BT_Z^e$ be the canonical ringed pullback/scalar comparisons [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback, lem-sfb-ringed-derived-monoidal-comparisons]. Then, for every $M\in D(Y_{\mathrm{et}},A)$,
$$\delta_{X,l_AM}\circ T_X^p(d_{A,M})\circ c^p_{C_Y^AM}=C_X^B(c^e_M)\circ d_{B,T_Y^eM}\circ p_B(\delta_{Y,M}).$$
Both sides are morphisms $p_BT_Y^pC_Y^AM\to C_X^BT_X^el_AM$. No quasi-compactness, quasi-separatedness, boundedness or flatness of $a$ is assumed.

source.place: Tag 0D6D, label lemma-derived-pullback-composition: ordinary module-pullback normalization, applied to the scalar/site cube

proof.text: Prove the ordinary restriction cube for the specified comparison inverse image and geometric inverse images. Write each restriction/pullback face as the conjugate of the sectionwise coextension/direct-image comparison, using the definitions in [def-weil-pbc-witness-compatibility] and [lem-sbc-canonical-restrict-scalars-functor-comparisons]. Write the site face as the conjugate of its direct-image square [sk-thm-pe-direct-image-comparison]. Conjugation is injective and exchanges composition and whiskering. Both conjugates agree sectionwise: the direct images are precomposition, coextension acts on values, and the site square is the same fiber-product isomorphism for both rings. This gives ordinary_restriction_cube, including the associators.

Apply the exact derived-square pasting theorem Functor.mapDerivedCategorySquareIso_hom_app_comp to the two ordinary routes, using ordinary_restriction_cube as its hypothesis on the site-face route. On the other route use identity composition comparisons. Expand the derived triangle comparisons and cancel the invertible common composition comparison. This yields exact_restriction_cube. Conjugate by the published identifications of exact geometric inverse images with left derived inverse images, and use their naturality to cancel adjacent inverse factors. The definitions of the derived restriction faces and the ambient site face give precisely derived_restriction_cube. Only exact fixed-coefficient operations are localized; scalar extension is not assumed exact.

Use the four scalar-extension/restriction adjunctions on the etale and pro-etale sites of X and Y. The comparison reduction is the inverse mate of the restriction/comparison face by [def-weil-pbc-witness-compatibility]. The two reverse scalar/pullback comparisons are the inverse mates of the two restriction/pullback faces, the constant-coefficient specializations used in [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback]. Apply the mates bijection to the two pasted scalar squares. Mate pasting [lem-weil-pbc-mate-pasting] and compatibility with whiskering turn their equality into derived_restriction_cube. Injectivity gives reverse_scalar_cube, without any direct-image isomorphism or boundedness assumption.

The published pro-etale scalar comparison is the inverse of the reverse mate, whose invertibility is the existing scalarPullbackReverse_isIso specialization of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback]. The proved private normalization identity scalarPullbackEtaleIso_eq_fromMate identifies the published normalized etale scalar comparison [def-pur-etale-scalar-pullback-iso] with the inverse etale mate. Precompose reverse_scalar_cube with the pro-etale forward comparison and postcompose with the comparison inverse image of the etale forward comparison. Cancel both inverse pairs and reverse the resulting equality. This is exactly the stated six-face equation.
